camel_example: aliyun ros ListChatSessions --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'CAES...' --AgentVersion V2 --MaxResults 20 --Mode IaCCodePipeline
description_en: Queries the ROS Agent V2 session list for the current user by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前用户的ROS Agent V2会话列表
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-chat-sessions --max-results 20 --next-token CAES... --agent-version V2 --biz-mode IaCCodePipeline --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListChatSessions

parameters.help_en: The number of sessions to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的会话数量，范围 1 到 100，默认值为 20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous response. Do not specify this parameter for the first page. Do not reuse an old token after switching the Mode
parameters.help_zh: 上一次响应返回的翻页 Token；第一页不传，切换 Mode 后不要复用旧 Token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to V2 to route requests to the ROS Agent V2 backend
parameters.help_zh: 传 V2 路由到 ROS Agent V2 后端
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.help_en: Filters sessions by mode. Valid values: IaCCodeNormal and IaCCodePipeline
parameters.help_zh: 按会话模式筛选，仅支持 IaCCodeNormal 或 IaCCodePipeline
parameters.name: mode

MaxResults.description_en: A compatibility field. This field is not returned in the current V2 response. Use the MaxResults request parameter instead
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前响应不返回，请以请求参数 MaxResults 为准

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. This field may not be returned or may be null on the last page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页 Token；最后一页可能不返回或为 null

Sessions.description_en: The list of sessions for the current user, sorted by update time in descending order
Sessions.description_zh: 当前用户的会话列表，按更新时间倒序

Mode.description_en: The session mode. Valid values: IaCCodeNormal and IaCCodePipeline
Mode.description_zh: 会话模式，取值为 IaCCodeNormal 或 IaCCodePipeline

PipelineName.description_en: The pipeline name. Valid values: EvaluationFirstSelling and SolutionFirstSelling
PipelineName.description_zh: 流水线名称，取值为 EvaluationFirstSelling 或 SolutionFirstSelling

SessionId.description_en: The session ID. You can use this ID to re-enter a session in StartChat, stop a session in StopChat, or query messages in ListChatMessages
SessionId.description_zh: 会话 ID，可用于 StartChat 重入、StopChat 和 ListChatMessages

Summary.description_en: The session summary. This field currently shares the same source as Title and may be empty
Summary.description_zh: 会话摘要，当前与 Title 同源，可能为空

Title.description_en: The session title. This field may be empty

UpdatedTime.description_en: A compatibility field. This field is not returned in the current V2 response. Use UpdatedAt instead
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 兼容字段。V2 当前响应不返回，请使用 UpdatedAt
